name: cloudflare-mcp-cli
stderr:
Usage: cloudflare-mcp-cli [options] [command]

CLI wrapper for the Cloudflare MCP server

Options:
  -V, --version             output the version number
  -t, --token <token>       Cloudflare API token (overrides stored token and
                            CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN)
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  config                    Manage stored configuration
  search <code>             Search the Cloudflare OpenAPI spec
  execute [options] <code>  Execute JavaScript code against the Cloudflare API
  agent                     Print usage guide for AI agents
  help [command]            display help for command
